title: 📱 2 Player Snake is now on iOS! 🐍🍎
author: toygun1725
selftext:
Hey everyone,

A few months ago, I shared **2 Player Snake** here — my multiplayer take on the classic Snake game — and asked for your feedback.

Today I’m excited to share a new milestone:

🍎 **2 Player Snake is now officially available on the App Store!**

You can now play on **iPhone, Android, or directly in your browser.**

🐍 Play locally with a friend on the same device — no Wi-Fi needed  
🌐 Play online against other players in real-time PvP  
⚡ Multiple game modes, from classic Snake to fast-paced competitive matches  
🏆 Unique modes like **Fast Competitive, Adventure, and Self Area 51**

The idea is still simple: take the classic Snake experience and turn it into a fun **2-player competitive game** you can play anywhere.

If you have an iPhone and a few minutes to try it, I’d really appreciate your feedback — especially on the controls, gameplay, and overall iOS experience.

🍎 **iOS:** [2 Player Snake – App Store](https://apps.apple.com/tr/app/2-player-snake/id6811546748)  
🤖 **Android:** [2 Player Snake – Google Play](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.twoplayersnake.app)  
💻 **PC / Browser:** [2playersnake.com](https://2playersnake.com/)

Thanks again to everyone who supported the project and gave feedback along the way. 💚🐍
